Get Involved

Bring your perspective to the lab.

Students, educators, scholars, schools, districts, and learning organizations can connect with the Digital Learning Lab in different ways.

Ways to work with us

Find your pathway.

G

Current UCI Graduate Students

Graduate students in Education or Information & Computer Science may contact Mark Warschauer about participating in lab research.

Contact Mark →
P

Prospective Graduate Students

Prospective students may consider applying to UCI’s PhD in Education program and review guidance for applicants interested in working with Professor Warschauer.

Explore the PhD program →Read the application FAQ →
U

Undergraduates

Undergraduates are invited to explore volunteer or for-credit research assistant opportunities in the lab.

View current openings →Watch the informational video →
V

Visiting Scholars

Prospective visiting scholars should provide a cover letter with proposed dates, funding, and research interests, plus a CV, writing sample, and references.

Contact Mark →
E

Educators & Schools

Bring forward ideas for research collaborations with a school, district, or learning program.

Propose a collaboration →

Explore customized talks, workshops, and longer programs on responsible AI for teaching and learning.

Getting here

By car: Park in UCI Parking Lot 1C. The lab is on the second floor of the Public Service Building, above the UCI Police Department and next to the parking office.

By rideshare or taxi: Use 410 East Peltason, Irvine as the destination and go to the building’s second floor.
